name: better-tasks
description: Plan and track tasks inside Claude Code, kept as plain Markdown files in your project, with weekly sprints, a sprint board and agent teammates.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Opens task files from the sprint board. auto: IntelliJ inside a JetBrains terminal, VS Code inside VS Code, else the default app. One of: auto, default, code, idea, cursor, zed.

worktree.title: Worktree per teammate
worktree.description: Old switch, kept for projects that set it: with the git flow "Straight to main", each named teammate works in its own git worktree. Choose the git flow in /better-tasks config.

longCache.title: 1-hour prompt cache
longCache.description: Teammates and the manager keep their prompt cache for an hour, so a teammate stays cheap to resume. Unless you set a TTL yourself.

statusEvery.title: Status check (minutes)
statusEvery.description: After this many quiet minutes the manager checks the open work and moves it forward. 0 turns it off.

maxTeammates.title: Team size (teammates)
maxTeammates.description: At most this many teammates at once; similar tasks go to the same teammate, one after another. 0: no limit.

keepAwake.title: Keep the Mac awake
keepAwake.description: Holds caffeinate while any teammate runs.

openPrInBrowser.title: Open PRs in the browser
openPrInBrowser.description: When the manager asks you to approve a finished task, it first opens that task's PR in your default browser.

demoVideos.title: Before/after videos
demoVideos.description: Teammates record the bug and the fix as one short video: BEFORE/AFTER labels, red boxes and arrows, subtitles read aloud by Kokoro (set up once per machine).

videoQuality.title: Video quality
videoQuality.description: The before/after videos' size: low = 720p small file, medium = 1080p (a few MB a minute), high = 1080p sharper, bigger file. One of: low, medium, high.

batchDeviceTests.title: Batch device tests
batchDeviceTests.description: When builds or device tests are slow, each task gets its own instance (simulator, emulator, app copy) where possible; else tasks that don't touch each other share one build, risky ones behind a short-lived feature flag that comes out once the task works.

pullRequests.title: PR per task
pullRequests.description: Old switch, kept for projects that set it: on means the git flow "Worktree and PR per task". Choose the git flow per project in /better-tasks config.

easyModel.title: Easy-task model
easyModel.description: The model teammates run on for quick, clear work: a typo, a text, a small fix. inherit: the manager's own model. One of: sonnet, opus, fable, haiku, inherit.

easyEffort.title: Easy-task effort
easyEffort.description: How hard teammates think on those tasks. One of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

normalModel.title: Normal-task model
normalModel.description: The model teammates run on for an ordinary feature or bug fix. inherit: the manager's own model. One of: sonnet, opus, fable, haiku, inherit.

normalEffort.title: Normal-task effort
normalEffort.description: How hard teammates think on those tasks. One of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

hardModel.title: Hard-task model
hardModel.description: The model teammates run on for deep debugging, security work, changes across several areas. inherit: the manager's own model. One of: sonnet, opus, fable, haiku, inherit.

hardEffort.title: Hard-task effort
hardEffort.description: How hard teammates think on those tasks. One of: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

escalate.title: Escalate when stuck
escalate.description: A teammate that fails or goes in circles is replaced by one a level up: easy to normal, normal to hard.

sprintWeeks.title: Sprint length (weeks)
sprintWeeks.description: How many weeks one sprint lasts. One of: 1, 2, 3, 4.

sprintStart.title: Sprint starts on
sprintStart.description: The weekday a sprint starts. One of: monday, tuesday, wednesday, thursday, friday, saturday, sunday.
